title: Fetch a verified blob batch
responsibility: Read a bounded batch of GitHub text blobs and verify their sizes and Git hashes.

inputs.name: githubGraphql.options
inputs.description: Repository identity (owner, name, id, installationId) plus a token callback, called once per batch with installationId, repositoryIds [repository.id] and permissions { contents: 'read' }, whose string result is sent as a Bearer token. The optional fetch replaces the global fetch for the POST to https://api.github.com/graphql, and the response's repository databaseId must equal repository.id.

inputs.name: githubGraphql.input
inputs.description: A commit and 1 to 64 entries read as one batch; each entry gives a repository path, the expected Git blob SHA and an optional byte size. Of each entry, only path, sha and size are read; the commit is not format-checked, type and mode are ignored, and the caller must supply entries from that commit's tree because this function never reads the tree.

outputs.name: githubGraphql
outputs.description: Resolves to a Map keyed by each entry path as given, whose value is the blob text encoded as UTF-8; a blob is accepted only if its oid equals the entry sha, its byteSize and any entry size equal that UTF-8 byte length, and the recomputed Git blob SHA-1 equals the entry sha. A missing path, a non-Blob object, a binary or truncated blob or any failed check fails the whole batch, and the response body must stay below 16 MiB (16777216 bytes).

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Every failure makes the promise reject with a plain Error whose message is 'Collaboration github-unavailable' and whose code property is 'github-unavailable', including an entry count outside 1 to 64, a failed token or fetch call, a non-OK or oversized response, invalid JSON or a non-empty GraphQL errors array, a repository databaseId mismatch, and any blob that fails the checks. No other error type escapes githubGraphql.
